description: Crypto token price in USD read on chain from Chainlink price feeds on Ethereum: up to 5 tickers per call (ETH, BTC, SOL, BNB, LINK...), each with feed address, round id and age. $0.001 per call over x402 (USDC on Arc, Base or Solana, or XNT on X1). Call once without `payment` for the terms, sign them with your own wallet, call again with `payment`.

payment.description: a signed x402 payment (the base64 payload you would put in PAYMENT-SIGNATURE). Pass it and the purchase completes inside this tool call.

symbols.description: one to five tickers, comma-separated, e.g. ETH,BTC

name: crypto_price
